sections.overview: Uromys imperator is a giant murid rodent endemic to Guadalcanal in the Solomon Islands.
sections.identification: Historical descriptions record dark grey, woolly fur that grades to a paler underside, with very short ears.
sections.habitat: Its confirmed historical material comes from Aola on northern Guadalcanal; the species’ wider habitat use remains uncertain.
sections.diet: A reliable species-specific diet has not been documented.
sections.behavior: The few historical specimens provide little direct evidence about its behavior.
sections.reproduction: Its reproductive biology is not described in the sources consulted.
sections.ecology: The revision documents only a few historical specimens; the related Uromys porculus is also known from scarce records, as its profile explains.
sections.conservation: The IUCN assessment lists it as Critically Endangered, Possibly Extinct; unconfirmed local reports are not equivalent to a verified rediscovery.
